# Original Album application

Source: `https://github.com/espressif/esp-mosaico-claw`, revision
`9ea326da1f2a017ba81f1d391862f977b355a03e`,
`fatfs_image/system/apps/album_app`.

The script and launcher manifest are unchanged. Script SHA-256:
`9324845e21df28b01284e0b06c01790366fb4ef095572cf104b6dece5a74b7ac`.

Licensed under Apache-2.0; upstream license is included as `LICENSE`.
The original script enumerates JPG, JPEG and LVGL BIN files. It does not enumerate
PNG or start worker jobs. Those module capabilities require independent tests.
